name: Ultimate Electrical LLC
old_description: Trusted, On-Time Electrical Solutions for Hawaii’s Homes & Businesses
about:
Ultimate Electrical LLC is a locally owned and operated electrical contractor based in Kailua-Kona on the Big Island of Hawaii. The company serves residential, commercial, and contractor clients across the island with a range of electrical installation, repair, and maintenance services.

Its service portfolio covers electrical repair and troubleshooting, indoor and outdoor wiring, electrical panel upgrades, generator installation and repair, smart-home electrical integration, commercial electrical systems, ductless mini-split air-conditioning installation, electric-vehicle charging station setup, complete solar photovoltaic solutions, and code-compliant pool and hot-tub wiring. The firm emphasizes licensed, insured technicians and 24/7 emergency availability.

Customers include homeowners seeking upgrades such as EV chargers or ceiling-fan installations, businesses needing commercial electrical work, and general contractors who subcontract electrical scopes. Testimonials cite same-day service for outlet repairs, next-day completion of car-charger corrections, and efficient multi-fixture installations for renovation projects.

The company states its mission is to deliver dependable electrical solutions that honor safety, quality, and community. Its published code of ethics highlights integrity, fair competition, excellence, teamwork, safety, service, respect, and privacy as guiding principles for every job.
